caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative object positioned centrally on the page. The object appears to be an ornately designed pedestal or lamp base rendered in shades of grey and white, with accents suggesting a metallic or glass material. The top of the object has a circular, gold or brass-colored cap. The main body is bulbous and features a repeating pattern of elongated, leaf-like motifs, bordered by rounded bead-like shapes near the top and bottom edges. The base transitions into a narrower, columnar section, similarly adorned with leaf patterns and beaded bands. The entire structure sits on a stepped, square platform base with an additional layer of beaded ornamentation. The background is a plain, beige color without any other objects or detailing, and in the lower left corner, a small linear scale is included.
title: Lamp
